title: Code Folding (zf, zo, zc)
instruction_text:
Collapse and expand sections of text!

'zf' in visual mode = create fold
'zo' = open fold
'zc' = close fold
'za' = toggle fold
'zR' = open all folds
'zM' = close all folds

Your task: The file has folding instructions.
Just add 'EDITED' at the end.

Steps:
1. Optional: Try selecting lines 2-4 with 'V'
2. Optional: Create fold with 'zf'
3. Optional: Try 'zo' to open, 'zc' to close
4. Go to last line (press 'G')
5. Press 'A' (append at end)
6. Type ' EDITED'
7. Press ESC
8. Save with :wq

Note: Folding is useful for large files!
For this lesson, just edit the text.
